text.text_excerpt: This is my all-time favorite food truck whenever I'm at school (LSUHSC New Orleans)! Chicken pad Thai is super cheap and the portion is huge! It's probably why it's the most popular dish besides the fact that it tastes so good! I never finished the pad Thai in one sitting. The workers are so nice and welcoming. I'd love to try other things on their menu as well.

My favorite Thai food truck! They're usually parked on Tulane Ave. weekday afternoons, and it's always my go to whenever I need to buy a lunch that can fill me up but is also not extremely expensive. I usually get their chicken pad Thai and add a $2 (!!!) Thai tea if I want to treat myself. For $7, the portion size of the chicken pad Thai is ample, and the food itself is good. I hear their curry puffs (when they have them in stock still) are a must try as well. The people who own the truck are also so friendly and so sweet. If you're in the area and have yet to try this place, what are you waiting for??

Thai Djing just started serving in the Point a few nights a week. Love walking to this great food truck and getting dinner. Tried it for the first time last night. Got the vegetable fried egg rolls, stuffed shrimp, and the Chicken Pad Thai. All really tasty! The stuffed shrimp were awesome! Two people working the truck. Serving good food with a smile! Note: they pack it all up for you so you can easily take it wherever you intend to enjoy it.
